title: Is a Pterodactyl Really Flying Over Mexico? Viral Video Explained
description:
Clips of a "pterodactyl" over Ciudad Juárez, Mexico went viral in November 2026. Pterosaurs died out about 66 million years ago, and experts say the footage is most likely AI or digital animation, or a misjudged bird such as a heron. As of November 21, 2026 there is no evidence of living pterosaurs, but Mexico does have real pterosaur fossils, like Muzquizopteryx from Coahuila. Illustrations are stylized, not real footage.
